recruiterCard.summary: This center stop introduces who I am, how this interactive island is organized, and the fastest path for recruiters to understand my experience, projects, and technical strengths.
impactBullets: Designed this environment to turn a portfolio into a guided, explorable recruiter experience instead of a static list of links.
Organized the island so work experience and projects can be scanned quickly while still leaving room for personal context and storytelling.
Built the world interaction flow to support both free exploration and direct navigation for hiring teams who want the highlights fast.
